metadata.description: Antigravity plugin for Claude Code: deep web research with citations, code rescue, task delegation, browser walkthrough recording, structured web scraping, document-to-markdown conversion, and visual/UX design review via Google Antigravity CLI (agy / Gemini 3.x). The modern successor to gemini-plugin-cc — no Node.js runtime, just seven slash commands and a thin Bash forwarder.

plugins.name: antigravity
plugins.description: Seven slash commands wrapping Google Antigravity CLI (agy): /agy:research (deep web research with citations, docs/agy/research/), /agy:rescue (code/diagnosis task delegation), /agy:record (browser walkthrough recording — .webm + optional MP4 via ffmpeg, docs/agy/recordings/), /agy:scrape (structured data extraction from URL — markdown or JSON, docs/agy/scrapes/), /agy:doc-to-md (PDF/docx/image to clean Markdown via multimodal Gemini, docs/agy/converted/), /agy:design-review (UX/visual audit with desktop+mobile screenshots and 10-dimension scoring, docs/agy/design-reviews/), /agy:setup (health check). Thin Bash forwarder, no runtime dependencies.
